normal_run.scope: bounded symbolic and fixture checks, not a formal proof of the research papers or a spectral tail certificate

uniform_gap.scope: exact finite algebra and constants; not the analytic compactness proof or a computed gamma
provenance: research/20260916_uniform_gap.tex: calibration, density budget, Noether application
checked: 109 Q bound with nonnegative 26 Z slack
forbidden Weyl trace, norm and determinant

conditions.Einstein_gap: MP(A), chi <= L A; analytic proof in paper; gamma is non-explicit
conditions.blowup_application: closed minimal general-type complex surface, b_plus > 1, A=c1^2 positive integer, k>=0
conditions.SW_ratio_formula: 1/3 < p=k/A < 1 and 0<=delta_minus<1; conclusion delta_minus/(1-delta_minus)>=sqrt((p-1/3)/2). If (2/3)(1-delta)^2-2delta^2<=0, the stronger ratio bound 1/sqrt(3) applies directly.

weyl10.scope: exact symbolic curvature symmetries and linearized Ricci on all 10 Weyl directions, with arbitrary radial jets
weyl10.normalization: orientation 0123; unnormalized self/anti-self-dual two-forms; C=sum A_ab omega_a tensor omega_b /4; K_ij=-C_ikjl xk xl/3
weyl10.radial_identity: DRic_e[eta(log r) K]=-(eta_tt+6 eta_t) K/(2 r^2), r>0
weyl10.limits: Does not estimate nonlinear gluing remainders, solve the ALE core equation, or prove global coverage.

ed_ricci.scope: independent exact full Ricci tensor from noncoordinate structure equations via Koszul and curvature contraction
structure_equations: de3=j e2 wedge e3+v e0 wedge e2
ed_ricci.parameters: j=tanh u, k=tanh t, v=a zeta' z'; j_u=1-j^2, k_t=1-k^2; v_t and v_u independent jets
ed_ricci.limits: Local tensor identity and norm algebra; not a computer proof of the closed bundle gluing, derivative bounds, or Einstein nonexistence.

cz_spike.scope: exact spike derivatives and independent complete Ricci/Riemann frame algebra; bounded numerical inner-disk diagnostics
provenance: step11_cz_spike_analytical.py (derivative family only; corrected background-energy claim)
research/20260916_construction.tex: small Ricci defect and full-curvature spikes

parameters.adaptation: Historical rho and Lambda family retained; a reduced inner-disk grid replaces the old cutoff grid. Numerical lower radius is max(sigma/10,1e-14); omitted core is not included in the sampled integral.

cz_spike.ricci_hessian_cancellation: all base Hessian entries cancel; fibers retain only +/-Delta u; u_xy remains in Riemann
cz_spike.volume_density: exp(F1+u+F2-u)=exp(F1+F2), so the perturbation preserves the local volume density

background_energy.fixed_ball: fixed-radius background energy remains; small perturbation energy is not vanishing full energy

cz_spike.limits: Grid values are not global sup bounds or interval certificates; no cutoff-collar energy is claimed here. This is not a Yau 26 counterexample.

negative_controls.mutation: closed full curvature energy claimed zero

four_node.scope: regression of a published truncated numerical matrix plus exact polarization and pattern arithmetic; no spectral recomputation
provenance: references/computations.md: step100_four_node_closure_and_q_diag.py, receiver graph and coefficient inputs
four_node.normalization: physical source S has coordinates (x,y,z)=(S22+S33,S22-S33,2*S23). Compact K contracts (S22,S33,2*S23); output is (R22,R33,R23). Receiver coordinates are (X,Y,Z)=(R22+R33,R22-R33,2*R23), zeta=(Y+iZ)/2, w=y+i*z.
four_node.pattern_assumption: q_diag=0 in the specified inter-node AA/BB channel; not measured by this fixture and not full geometric reduction

patterns.result: no opposite-chirality source constraint; no existence conclusion
fixture necessary windows disjoint when q_diag=0

four_node.pattern_symmetry: The five rows retain r0,r1,r2-diagonal,r2-adjacent,r3 relative to a fixed positive background; r4 is not listed and global reversal is not taken as a geometric equivalence. Only at the opposite-source-graph level, both all-equal assignments have empty graphs and r1/r3 are isomorphic under square symmetry. This does not identify fillings or full equations.
four_node.limits: Rounded fixture decimals are exact regression inputs, not exact spectral coefficients. No tail bound, discretization certificate, full nonlinear reduction, or global Einstein obstruction is asserted.
